thread:
denise: Heads-up — dashboards are noticeably slow on the EU canary after today's console rollout. Heatmaps + sparklines hang ~800-1200ms on first interaction. Repro on staging and canary. Anyone else seeing this?
aj: I can repro on my laptop. Main thread parse+execute up ~300-500ms. DevTools shows a big parse hit from telemetry import + charting-core chunk.
maya: adding traces — sentry shows a spike at telemetry:init and then protoSerialize. Also seeing kvcache misses spike for the heatmap tiles.
liam: saw that too. We changed routing affinity yesterday which widened distribution, increasing cold-cache hits. Could be interacting with the telemetry client doing heavy serialize on first paint.
denise: can we rollback the canary while we triage?
deploy-bot: Deploy group 'console-canary' rolled back by @liam at 12:03 UTC — reason: perf regression (automated rollback).
aj: rollback makes sense. Quick hypothesis: some widgets still `import 'telemetry/client'` eagerly in module top-level. If we switch those to dynamic import() the initial parse should shrink.
maya: +1. Also telemetry sampling config was bumped earlier (samplesPerFlush x10) — that increases CPU work on init. We should revert or offload serialization to a worker.
liam: agree on two fronts: 1) lazy-load telemetry, 2) revert the routing affinity tweak for kvcache until we confirm. Both are low-risk canary toggles.
aj: patch plan: change eager imports in legend/heatmap to `import('telemetry/client').then(t => t.init(...))` and split legend into its own chunk. Minimal change, keeps telemetry API intact.
maya: I'll instrument the telemetry client to emit simple CPU metrics (serialize_ms) so we can see client-side cost in the observability dashboard.
liam: also add a temporary feature flag `telemetry_lazy_init` so we can flip without deploy.
denise: rollout plan?
aj: propose canary: EU only, 5% traffic, toggles: telemetry_lazy_init=true, revert_routing_affinity=true. Monitor main-thread parse, LCP, and kvcache miss rate.
maya: set perf alert: LCP > 800ms for >3m -> auto-rollback. Also chart parse budget: main-thread parse > 250ms -> alert.
aj: creating branch now and small PR. Command I'm running locally: `git checkout -b fix/telemetry-lazyload && yarn build:console --split-legend`
liam: I'll add the routing revert to the infra rollout patch.
aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7890 — tiny change, lazy import + chunk name tweak.
maya: starting 5% EU canary with both toggles enabled. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for console-canary: 5% EU (build 2022.1724) — toggles: telemetry_lazy_init=true, revert_routing_affinity=true.
maya: initial metrics at 10m: LCP back to baseline, main-thread parse down ~320ms -> 90ms improvement, kvcache miss rate down slightly. Continuing to monitor for 1h.
liam: if this stays stable, we can promote to 20% and then globally. Also add a postmortem note to review the routing affinity change that caused cold-cache spread.
denise: thanks everyone — solid triage & quick fix. Follow-up: schedule a short doc session on safe routing policy rollouts + perf telemetry best practices. :thumbsup:
